description: Housekeeping: fix dependency drift, create scripts/ stub, and annotate legacy canvas class. Independent of FEAT-002/003/004 — no shared file edits except requirements.txt, scripts/README.md, and parallel_canvas.py.
steps: Edit f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Agent\requirements.txt: keep existing entries (flask, flask-cors, requests, psutil, pyautogui, pillow, pycaw, comtypes, screen-brightness-control, pyperclip, pywin32, PyQt6>=6.11.0, PyQt6-WebEngine>=6.11.0). Create f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Agent\scripts\README.md with content: '# scripts/ — Not Yet Implemented

The scripts referenced in tools.json (OPEN_VSCODE.ps1, MUTE_VOLUME.py, OPEN_BROWSER.py, SCREENSHOT.py, LIST_FILES.py, OPEN_NOTEPAD.ps1, SYSTEM_INFO.py, CLOSE_APP.py, SHUTDOWN.py, CANCEL_SHUTDOWN.py, GET_TIME.py, TYPE_TEXT.py, SEARCH_GOOGLE.py, SET_BRIGHTNESS.py, EMPTY_RECYCLE_BIN.py, CREATE_FOLDER.py, DELETE_FILE.py, PLAY_PAUSE_MEDIA.py, LOCK_SCREEN.py, OPEN_APP.py, CLIPBOARD_COPY.py, START_OLLLAMA_SERVER.py, DESCRIBE_SCREEN.py, READ_SCREEN.py, FIND_ON_SCREEN.py, CLICK_ELEMENT.py) are **not yet implemented**.

`tools.json` is a declarative registry used by the AI agent to discover available OS-level tools. The actual script files listed above must be created before these tools can be executed. Do NOT delete tools.json.'
Install dev dependencies from requirements.txt into the venv: run `f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Agent\venv\Scripts\pip install pytest==8.3.4 pytest-asyncio==0.24.0` so later FEATs can run tests.

Edit f:\Shreyash DOC\shreyash\Agent\parallel_canvas.py: in the ParallelCanvasDesktop class body, insert the following as the first line of the class docstring (replacing the existing docstring): 'LEGACY: This class is the synchronous Playwright implementation and is NOT used by the primary server (parallel_desktop_server.py uses AsyncParallelDesktop directly). Retained for reference only. Do not instantiate from server code.\n\nParallel AI Desktop Canvas running in an isolated Chromium process.' Do NOT change any method signatures or logic.
